name: Oda Nobunaga
subtitle: Demon Daimyo
description: Lead your clan to victory with powerful self-buffs, stat gains and joint Attacks
lore: A great daimyo before the Shattering, Oda Nobunaga led a series of wars that largely unified the provinces. Now he is a figure around which much of Izumo’s mortal population has rallied—but some lords of the realm choose to remain independent. Believing only a united Izumo can survive Ryven, Oda Nobunaga again readies himself to lead a war of unification.
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when this hero has their Divinity or Turn Meter increased.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Unify the Realms
DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, C.DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, Divinity Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Unify the Realms
skills.description: Increase the damage inflicted by this hero by 10% and reduces the damage received by 10% each time this hero defeats an enemy (stacking up to 5 times).
skills.awakening_bonus: Stacks are not reset across each wave.

skills.name: Unyielding Ambition
skills.description: Attacks all enemies then place [mechanic:spd-up-ii] and [mechanic:init-up-ii] on this hero for 2 turns. If this attack defeats an enemy, the buffs cannot be removed.

skills.name: Daimyo Claim
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy then increase this hero's Divinity by 5%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increase an additional 2% Divinity for each enemy this hero has defeated in the battle.

skills.name: Imperial Conquest
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. All allies join the attack with their basic abilities. Izumo allies inflict 30% increased damage. Increase Turn Meter of this hero by 50% if an enemy is defeated.
skills.awakening_bonus: Turn Meter increase is now 100% when defeating an Enemy.

imprint_passive: Increase the damage inflicted by this hero by 5% and reduces the damage received by 5% each time this hero defeats an enemy (stacking up to 5 times).
